function.name: elephant_population_estimate
function.description: Estimate future population of elephants given current population and growth rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

growth_rate.description: The annual population growth rate of elephants. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years to project the population.

Actually the function expects current_population, growth_rate, years. They gave future population and growth_rate. We need current population to compute future. But we can solve for current population: future = current * (1+growth_rate)^years. So current = future / (1+growth_rate)^years. So we can compute current population. So current = 35000 / 1.077284 ≈ 32480. So current population ~32480. But the user might want to estimate future population given current population? They gave future estimate.
